sources.title: Mehryar Mohri, Afshin Rostamizadeh, and Ameet Talwalkar, Foundations of Machine Learning, 2nd ed. (MIT Press, 2018)
sources.locator: Complete 505-page second edition fetched and inspected. Chapter 2 §§2.1–2.4 for PAC/risk definitions; Chapter 3 §§3.1–3.3, Theorems 3.3, 3.5, 3.7, Corollaries 3.8–3.9, Definition 3.10, Examples 3.11–3.12, Theorems 3.13 and 3.17, Corollaries 3.18–3.19, and Exercise 3.30. VC results are printed pp. 31–43 (PDF pp. 48–60); Exercise 3.30 is printed pp. 57–58 (PDF pp. 74–75).

contents.name: Chapter 2: risk notation and finite-sample realizable/agnostic PAC probability criteria
contents.reason: The local definition extends these criteria to risk-measurable rules valued in possibly infinite H and states exactly which selector properties are not implied.

contents.name: Definition 3.10: VC dimension of a hypothesis class; indexed trace convention
contents.reason: The local definition spells out repeated indices and the empty tuple explicitly.

contents.name: Definition 3.6 and equation (3.19): growth function and sample dichotomies
contents.reason: The indexed trace-cardinality definition and maximum convention are stated locally.

contents.name: Theorem 3.17 and Corollary 3.18: Sauer bound and (em/d)^d estimate with complete proof
contents.reason: The local proof transports the finite-family theorem to indexed samples and proves the binomial estimate; it preserves the corrected <= d-1 line in Theorem 3.17.

contents.name: Theorems 3.3, 3.5, 3.7, Corollaries 3.8–3.9: symmetrization, bounded differences, finite maximum, and growth-function route
contents.reason: The local chaining proof obtains an explicit empirical Rademacher constant from the inspected covering entropy supplier.

contents.name: Corollary 3.19: exact one-sided VC deviation term and confidence term
contents.reason: The local statement preserves the exact square-root terms and states the required AC branch inherited from bounded differences.

contents.name: Theorem 3.3 proof: ghost-sample symmetrization and one-sided uniform deviation
contents.reason: The local proof expands the symmetrization, complexity estimate, bounded-differences concentration, and complementary loss branch.

contents.name: Exercise 3.30: realizable finite-VC sample-complexity rate
contents.reason: The source poses the rate; the local carrier supplies a complete double-sample proof and explicit sufficient constant.

contents.name: Theorem 3.3/Corollary 3.19 risk-bound context for approximate ERM
contents.reason: The local proof uses its own two-sided deviation supplier and spells out the ERM comparison and constants.

sources.title: Shai Shalev-Shwartz and Shai Ben-David, Understanding Machine Learning: From Theory to Algorithms (Cambridge University Press, 2014)
sources.locator: Complete 449-page textbook. contents.name: Chapter 6 Example 6.2 and §6.3.1: threshold class has VC dimension one
contents.reason: The source uses the complementary threshold convention; the local example uses h_t(x)=1[x<=t] and proves the same trace count directly.

contents.name: Chapter 6 §6.3.2: intervals have VC dimension two
contents.reason: The source uses open intervals while the local carrier uses closed bounded intervals; its shattering and forbidden-pattern argument agrees with the locally verified trace count.

contents.name: Chapter 9 §9.1.3, Theorems 9.2–9.3: homogeneous and affine halfspaces
contents.reason: The source gives the lower witness and dependence-based upper bound; the local proof writes the affine dependence argument in full under the stated >=0 label convention.

contents.name: Chapter 6 §6.3.4: finite classes have VC dimension at most log2 of their cardinality
contents.reason: This finite-class estimate is not the assigned infinite singleton-class example and is not needed for any assigned item.
